gumtree_entries.description: DELETED o1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Mon Jun 15 04:55:52 GMT 2026
DELETED o2: Undeclared exception!
DELETED o3: Value in list -2047 is less than 0
DELETED o4: Undeclared exception!
DELETED o5: Value in list 31 is greater than maximum value (30)
ADDED i1: processBitMaps stops and returns false when the underlying LongBiPredicate returns false after the first call. The filter being processed (shape 2x775) is large
ADDED i2: Bitmap array from the small (empty) filter — one long of zeros
ADDED i3: Predicate returns true on first test, then false — causing early termination
ADDED i4: processBitMaps returns false immediately when the predicate always returns false.
ADDED i5: After merging a hasher into a filter, processBitMaps stops early when the predicate fails on a bitmap element that does not match the single-element reference a
ADDED i6: Single-element array of zeros used as the reference bitmap
ADDED i7: Merging a filter with itself via BitMapExtractor succeeds and both merge operations return true.
ADDED i8: Merging an IndexExtractor containing a negative index throws IllegalArgumentException because negative bit indices are invalid.
ADDED i9: Merging an IndexExtractor whose index equals the number of bits in the shape throws IllegalArgumentException because valid indices are 0..numberOfBits-1.
ADDED i10: Shape has 31 bits (indices 0–30); index 31 is out of range
ADDED i11: Merging a mocked LayeredBloomFilter into a SparseBloomFilter succeeds even when the layer manager's processBloomFilters returns false.
ADDED i12: After merging a hasher into a filter shaped for 833 bits across 14 longs, asBitMapArray returns an array of exactly 14 longs.
ADDED i13: Calling clear() on a SparseBloomFilter resets it; characteristics() still returns SPARSE (value 1) because the type does not change after clearing.
ADDED i14: A newly created SparseBloomFilter with no elements merged is empty.
ADDED i15: An empty SparseBloomFilter trivially contains itself because no bits need to be present in the other filter.
ADDED i16: estimateIntersection does not alter the filter's type; characteristics() still returns SPARSE (value 1) after the call.
